notes: Read all 184 numbered source lines before editing. Covered: imports L1-21 (useMemo, react-i18next useTranslation, @/lib/cn, the 11 lucide icons, GlassPanel, EmptyState, FadeIn, SecurityEvent type, asNonEmptyString); the LiveSignal interface L27-33; boolLabel L35-38; buildLiveSignals L40-127 (all 10 signal descriptors hazards/highBeams/turnSignal/driverSeat/pairedKeys/valetMode/serviceMode/speedLimit/homelinkDevices/centerDisplay); LiveVehicleStateProps L133-135; the component L137-184 (useTranslation, useMemo deps [latest, t], FadeIn>GlassPanel, header h2 + live indicator, the length>0 tile grid map, and the EmptyState fallback).

Preserved every identifier, key, value, and active expression verbatim: buildLiveSignals + boolLabel + the LiveSignal {key,label,value,active} shape; the SecurityEvent snake-of-camel fields lightsHazardsActive/lightsHighBeams/lightsTurnSignal/driverSeatOccupied/pairedPhoneKeyCount/valetModeEnabled/serviceMode/speedLimitMode/homelinkDeviceCount/centerDisplay (imported from the matching native SecurityEvent in api/hooks/useAdmin); the !!x active coercions, the (count ?? 0) > 0 guards, the typeof speedLimitMode === 'boolean' branch, and the IIFE `!!s && !s.toLowerCase().includes('off')` active checks for turnSignal/speedLimit/centerDisplay. The web '—' em-dash fallback is preserved as '\u2014'.

i18n: react-i18next useTranslation -> a native key/English-default `t` fallback (useNativeT) preserving every key + default verbatim — admin.security.on 'On', admin.security.off 'Off', admin.security.live.{hazards,highBeams,turnSignal,driverSeat,occupied,empty,pairedKeys,valetMode,serviceMode,speedLimit,homelinkDevices,centerDisplay}, admin.security.liveState 'Live Vehicle State', admin.security.live.indicator 'Live', admin.security.live.noData 'No live state data available'. useMemo deps [latest, t] kept (t stable via useCallback).

asNonEmptyString (web @/lib/typeGuards) inlined verbatim — native has no typeGuards module — keeping the 'never coerce a non-string to a string' narrowing so a boolean false in a string-typed signal field never matches the 'off' checks. @/lib/cn className join -> conditional StyleSheet style arrays (glyphActive/glyphInactive, valueActive/valueInactive).

Native-safe swaps, no DOM/Recharts/Leaflet/framer-motion/lucide-react imports: FadeIn (framer-motion entrance, delay 0.17) collapses to a static GlassPanel root (delay is non-behavioural; no Animated, avoiding open handles under --detectOpenHandles). GlassPanel (outer + per-tile) -> shared native GlassPanel; the web `hover` prop has no touch parity and is dropped. The 10 lucide icons are colour-bound to active state (text-cyan-400 vs --text-muted) which the bordered SemanticIcon chip cannot reproduce, so each collapses to a 2-char glyph (HZ/HB/TS/DS/KY/VM/SM/SL/HL/CD) rendered as AppText switching colors.accent (active) <-> colors.textMuted; the CircleDot animate-pulse indicator -> a static '\u25CF' success dot + 'Live' (colors.success ~ green-400). h2 text-lg/font-semibold/text-gray-200 -> AppText 18px/600/textPrimary with accessibilityRole=header; the 10px font-medium muted label and text-sm font-semibold white/muted value reproduced with AppText numberOfLines={1}.

EmptyState: web calls it with only `message` (title omitted, optional on web); the native shared EmptyState requires a title, so the title-less centred message is reproduced inline (View + muted AppText) to match the web's actual output, preserving the admin.security.live.noData copy and the no-action transient-empty-state comment. The responsive grid-cols-2 sm:3 lg:5 collapses to a flex-wrap grid (flexBasis 42% + minWidth 130 + flexGrow) defaulting to two columns on phone and growing on wider screens — RN has no CSS media-query breakpoints. testID hooks added (live-vehicle-state / -indicator / -grid / -empty / live-signal-<key>) for parity tests. Gates run from apps/native: npm run typecheck; npm run lint -- --quiet; npm test -- --runInBand --detectOpenHandles.
